description: Pre-existing fork noticed during the fz-kdt.137 cold review; folded into the fold arc because the fix is a deletion. Six implementations of 'does this tuple's arity satisfy this predicate' exist. Two are pure deletions: TupleShapes::admits_arity (runtime_type_predicate.rs ~814) is a verbatim copy of FiniteSet::contains (finite_set.rs ~67); runtime_test.rs ~369-372 recomputes shapes().map(len).sort().dedup(), the set TupleShapes::exact already stores (~770). The fork itself: tuple_positions (~272) and matches_other_struct_axis (~1493) both read the arities the predicate NAMES; runtime_test.rs ~338-346 other_flag excludes every registered tuple schema id, built from tuple_arities_at_every_depth (native_codegen/driver.rs ~46), so it includes nested arities, and the native boxed emitter is the sole outlier. emit_tuple_arity_membership's cofinite branch (~454-462) already computes the right set: delete ~337-346 and call it with FiniteSet { values: arities.values, cofinite: true }; rename it emit_arity_set_membership. Also route receive.rs ~1529-1561 emit_tuple_arity_test (the only door bypassing the predicate for Region::TupleArity) and ir_interp/backend.rs ~3389 is_tuple_arity through RuntimeTypePredicate::tuple_arity(n). Not foldable: the schema-id paths that separate a named struct from a tuple (both ValueKind::STRUCT at runtime); tuple_positions presumes that separation. Signal: a fixture with allow_other_structs plus a nested tuple arity agreeing on three doors; record the decision in runtime_test.rs's moduledoc.
title: [BUG] allow_other_structs admits different arities on the interpreter matcher and the native boxed emitter when the tuple axis names a nested arity
